step1_analysis.description: The circuit is an unfooted dynamic non-inverting buffer, consistent with the paper's focus on dynamic logic styles. It uses a precharge PMOS (XM1) and a pre-discharge NMOS (XM3) driven by complementary clocks, with an evaluation NMOS (XM4) and an output driving PMOS (XM2).

paper_reference.title: Dynamic Current Mode Logic (DyCML): A New Low-Power High-Performance Logic Style

propagation_delay.description: Delay from input rising to output rising during the evaluation phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: tpd ~ C_load * VDD / I_on. With W=5u, L=0.5u, I_on ~ 1mA. C_load ~ 20fF. tpd ~ 20fF * 1.8V / 1mA ~ 36ps. Adding internal node delays, expect ~50-100ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper value is for a full 16-bit CLA. A single dynamic gate in 130nm is extremely fast and will have a delay in the tens of picoseconds.
The paper value is for a full 16-bit adder. A single gate consumes proportionally less power, dominated by dynamic switching power.

rise_time.description: Time for output N1 to transition from 20% to 80% of VDD.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard transition time for a loaded gate in 130nm.

sky130_expected.calculation: Full swing CMOS output from VDD to GND.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Despite DyCML being a reduced swing logic family, this specific dynamic buffer stage restores full VDD to GND swing.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure propagation delay, rise time, voltage swing, and average power of the dynamic logic buffer at 400 MHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dynamic Logic Buffer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* CLK (LABEL_NET_0) - Precharge when low (400 MHz)
VCLK LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 20p 20p 1.23n 2.5n)

* CLK_B (LABEL_NET_1) - Pre-discharge N1 when high
VCLKB LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 20p 20p 1.23n 2.5n)

* IN (LABEL_NET_2) - High during first evaluate phase, Low during second
* Must be strictly 0 during precharge to avoid short circuits in unfooted dynamic logic
VIN LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1.3n 20p 20p 1.0n 5.0n)

* Load Capacitance
Cload1 N0 0 10f
Cload2 N1 0 10f

.control
  tran 10p 6n

  * Measure Voltage Swing
  meas tran v_max max v(N1)
  meas tran v_min min v(N1)
  let v_swing = v_max - v_min
  print v_swing

  * Measure Delay (IN to N1 during evaluate)
  meas tran t_delay trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1
  print t_delay

  * Measure Rise Time of N1
  meas tran t_rise trig v(N1) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.44 rise=1
  print t_rise

  * Measure Power
  meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=5n
  let power_w = -pwr_avg * 1.8
  print power_w

  quit
.endc
.end
